verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll is a SaaS payroll service, so an official MCP server is a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The GraphQL Workforce API, webhooks and llms.txt are developer building blocks that an MCP server could be built on. They do not earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
